rule.positive_primary: strict complete relation F1 > MCR-only; separately identify recovered-TP cases and improvement beyond RelationOnly
rule.selection_of_cases: lexicographic first per outcome, plus lexicographic first TP-recovery and BRJ-over-RelationOnly cases; list all positive IDs
rule.extension_trigger: After completing all first-wave documents, if a corpus has no strict relation F1 improvement, expand only that corpus by the next 4 ranks per length stratum (up to 16 documents per complete wave), preserving all prior outcomes
rule.stop: Stop once both corpora contain an improvement after a completed wave, or each lacking-positive corpus exhausts its preordered unique audit-text pool; never tune scores or redraw candidates using gold
rule.inference_limit: Outcome-adaptive expansion is case discovery; no significance testing, generalization, or independent-test claim

adaptation: Outcome determines whether to run next frozen block, never which documents or scores enter it
